name: onshape
description: Onshape 云端 CAD。用用户自己的 API key 创建文档、零件工作室和装配，提交特征编辑，导入文件并导出。删除只登记显式对象，不发送删除。未配置时不启动，不创建密钥。

onshape_access_key.title: ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY
onshape_access_key.description: Required Onshape API access key from the user's own Developer Portal key pair. No default. This package does not create a key. Unset disables the adapter.

onshape_secret_key.title: ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY
onshape_secret_key.description: Required Onshape API secret key. No default. Not logged. This package does not create a key. Unset disables the adapter.

onshape_base_url.title: ONSHAPE_BASE_URL
onshape_base_url.description: Required Onshape stack origin, for example https://cad.onshape.com. No default. Origin only: no user, path, or query. Unset disables the adapter.
